episodic_summary: As of 19 October, 2023, Calvin reaches out to Dave after a few days of silence, sharing that a lot has happened since they last spoke. He excitedly announces that he has started touring with Frank Ocean, describing the experience as amazing due to the energy from the crowd and the connection he feels when performing on stage, which he describes as unreal. Calvin shares an image of a band performing on stage with bright lights to illustrate his experience. Dave congratulates Calvin, expressing that playing music to a crowd and feeling that connection must be unreal. Dave inquires about how the tour is going, and Calvin responds that the tour is great, with the energy from the crowd being awesome and jamming with Frank Ocean being a dream come true. Dave expresses his amazement, stating that performing with Frank Ocean must feel like a dream come true and asks how it happened. Calvin explains that they met at a festival in August of the previous year, where Frank Ocean expressed a desire to collaborate. Calvin mentions that they clicked right away, noting the incredible chemistry they have on stage. He shares another photo showing how perfectly they look together on stage, illustrating their connection. Dave praises Calvin and Frank's synergy, stating that it is clear they rock on stage and expresses eagerness to catch Calvin's show.
